description: A list's firms in the 66-column export shape plus suggested_route, route_evidence and route_next_action, 200 rows per page as JSON. Each page opens its firms: a firm counts once per seat per calendar month toward the allowance of 500 firms a month, and firms already opened this month (in the portal, through MCP or in an earlier export) are free. Firms past the allowance come back as teasers in blocked_firms. Up to 300 contacts per export (then contact columns are blank and contacts_truncated is true).
name: export_list
title: Export a list
